title: Session Title Hooks via hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle (v2.1.94)
description: UserPromptSubmit hooks can now return hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle to programmatically set or override the session title. Enables hooks to auto-tag sessions based on prompt content, project context, or time-of-day. Useful for evolution heartbeat sessions — could auto-title them 'Heartbeat 2026-04-10' without manual naming, making /resume picker navigation cleaner.

evaluation.reasoning: UserPromptSubmit hook is already active; adding sessionTitle return field is low-effort. Directly solves the /resume picker navigation problem for heartbeat sessions ('Heartbeat 2026-04-10' instead of UUID-style names). Implementation: update ~/.claude/hooks/user-prompt-submit.sh to detect heartbeat prompts and return hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle.
